description: This Java source file defines the EwayServices class, which provides static methods for handling payment transactions through the eWay payment gateway, including charge, refund, and release operations.

classes.name: EwayServices
classes.description: Utility class providing static methods to interact with eWay payment gateway for charging, refunding, and releasing payments.

methods.name: ewayCharge
methods.description: Initiates a payment charge through eWay using provided context and payment details.

methods.name: ewayRefund
methods.description: Processes a refund for a previous transaction via eWay.

methods.name: ewayRelease
methods.description: Releases a hold on payment, effectively a refund or cancellation, for a specific transaction.

methods.name: initRequest
methods.description: Initializes a GatewayRequest object with configuration parameters for a transaction or refund.

methods.name: getPaymentGatewayConfigValue
methods.description: Retrieves configuration values for a payment gateway, either from the database or properties.
